name: Algernon Sidney Gilbert
role: Church agent and storekeeper in Zion
dateNote: He was baptized in spring 1831, went to Missouri in June 1831, and died of cholera in Clay County, Missouri, on 29 June 1834.
importance: Section 53 answers his prayer about his calling in June 1831. Section 57 makes him the Church’s agent in Zion, to buy land and open a store. He joined the United Firm (78, 82). After the Jackson County expulsion, section 101 tells him not to sell the storehouse.
connections: He was the business partner of Newel K. Whitney in Kirtland. He worked with Edward Partridge and William W. Phelps in Missouri.

sources.title: Algernon Sidney Gilbert, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: JSP: born 28 Dec. 1789, New Haven, Connecticut; partner in N. K. Whitney & Co. by 1827; baptized spring 1831; agent June 1831; jailed seven days Nov. 1833; died 29 June 1834 near Rush Creek, Clay County. Death date read from the end of the page’s date range.
